verdict.rationale: Gemini's own docs say developers can analyze multimodal inputs. The Live API takes real-time voice and vision input, and the API terms describe prompts that include files such as images, videos, or documents, so the core capability is documented. The evidence is only high-level summary statements, with no dedicated per-modality input docs, so full story coverage is not shown. missing for 10: dedicated documentation for image, audio, and document (e.g. PDF) input in standard generateContent requests, supported formats/size limits per modality, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can send images, audio, or documents to the model — or the docs honestly scope the model to text-only input
